block.comment: Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Read a DS18B20 temperature and show it on an I2C character LCD. Check the sensor pull-up and LCD address. Wiring: HD44780 I2C LCD: address 0x27; DS18B20: PIN D2; I2C SDA A4, SCL A5; Powered DS18B20: data needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to VCC. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Warm the DS18B20, then change the temperature label or LCD row.
